messages:
nina: Quick expense question  I paid for a cab and small luggage fee on the corp card. Bank shows single 'CITYCOACH' charge $42.50. Receipt I scanned shows fare $35 + luggage fee $7.50. Manager approved. How should I code?
paul: @nina upload the receipt to Expensify and add a short note splitting the two amounts. We'll code fare to 6300 and luggage to 6320 (travel:ancillary). Attach manager approval.
finance-bot: Policy reminder: ancillary fees (baggage, seat selection) are allowed when travel is business-related. Aggregated merchant descriptors are common; attach the itemized receipt and include manager sign-off. Transactions under $50 with receipts are auto-processed in 3 business days.
nina: Done: uploaded `receipt_8899_cab.pdf` and added manager tag. Thanks!
paul: Approved. AP will split the single bank line into two GL entries and close. :white_check_mark:
